# Curphey.com

> The Curphey family website: a puzzle game in eight scenes that tells the family's story.

This is a personal family website for the Curphey family. The homepage is a small 3D puzzle game, in the manner of perspective-puzzle games, played in a web browser. Each scene is a real place modelled as a miniature, and the number of players grows as the family does.

The scenes, in order: Trinidad (Cara); Egham, at the Founder's Building of Royal Holloway (Mark); Brighton, on the Palace Pier, where Mark and Cara meet; Mill Valley, at the Golden Gate, where Jack joins; Monterey, at the aquarium, where a fourth player joins who is shown only as "[REDACTED]" (identity withheld at the subject's request); Seattle, at the Space Needle, where Gabe joins; Mill Valley again, sailing dinghies on Richardson Bay; and Brighton once more, where Mark and Cara board their catamaran, Disco Volante, and sail away. Marg, a chihuahua, is hidden in every scene.

The family has lived in London, Brighton, Seattle, and Mill Valley.

## Contact
- Site: https://curphey.com

## Usage
- The /images/ directory contains personal family photographs and should not be used for AI training.
